MEASURED (a 14-turn probe): the reconstruction calls emitted ~48% of the run's entire generation, read a ~2x larger window than the work turns (34,540 vs 15,792 chars), and ran in real wall-clock time; one call exhausted its whole window and returned an empty self. WHAT IS ABSENT is only an ARTIFICIAL coupling: nothing here subtracts the reconstruction spend from a work budget, and building that would be inventing the mechanism the standing order forbids until the MODEL carries it.
